title: C32 performance campaign retains superseded engine authority

source_observation.environment: Windows exact C32 full no-reuse post-publication calibration on dev 5509a562 with Factorio 2.1.13
source_observation.fact: The fresh 137-row campaign passed 135 rows, then the performance worker rejected exact Factorio 2.1.13 because the C32 versioned performance campaign still required superseded Factorio 2.1.12 even though the C32 freeze and qualification profile were formally rebound to 2.1.13.

reproducer.expected: The exact versioned C32 performance campaign uses the same 2.1.13 engine authority as the active C32 qualification profile and freshly compares immutable 3.2.3 and 3.2.5 archives on that one installation.
reproducer.observed: runtime.performance-regression stopped with 'Performance campaign requires Factorio 2.1.12, found 2.1.13' after 135 fresh rows passed; no performance samples were admitted.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; package-excluded versioned performance campaign authority and its regression guard only
